item.title: Self-Hosted SMTP Milter Management: milter-manager vs rspamd vs OpenDKIM
item.description: The Milter (Mail Filter) API is Sendmail and Postfix protocol that allows external programs to inspect and modify email messages during the SMTP transaction. Milters are the backbone of server-side email security — handling spam detection, DKIM signing, virus scanning, content filtering, and policy enforcement. This guide compares three open-source milter implementations: milter-manager (unified milter framework), rspamd (high-performance spam filter with milter interface), and OpenDKIM (DKIM signing and verification via milter).
